title: Set canonical and Open Graph URL metadata to swamisamarth.icp.app

requirements.summary: Add canonical URL and Open Graph URL metadata pointing to https://swamisamarth.icp.app in the base HTML document.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html includes a <link rel="canonical" href="https://swamisamarth.icp.app" /> tag.
frontend/index.html includes a <meta property="og:url" content="https://swamisamarth.icp.app" /> tag.
The site still loads correctly at the root path (/) and existing routes continue to work.

file_operations.description: Add <link rel="canonical" href="https://swamisamarth.icp.app" /> and <meta property="og:url" content="https://swamisamarth.icp.app" /> within the <head> section, keeping existing metadata intact to avoid impacting routing or load behavior.
